title: Retire the remaining prose pointers to ticks files chz deleted outside skills/ticks/references
body: extensions/ticks-runner/* (contracts/job-protocol.json, contracts/lifecycle-invariants.json's file field, cloudflare/src/toml.ts and run-room.ts, image/README.md, internal/factory/lifecycle/invariants_test.go) and runners-config.md's ticks-schemas/ codegen rationale still describe ticks files that no longer exist at v0.32.0. They read as provenance rather than links, and two are in contract files that need a bundle re-cut, so dz1 left them; references_test.go's guard could be widened to extensions/ticks-runner once they are reworded.
